# A01-S05: Collaboration proposal

Extract from the operator’s source text. Omitted passages are marked […].

[…]

Here is a short inquiry about whether you are seeking collaborations or employees for your project.

My name is [the operator] and I am newly graduated philosopher and practicing artist. I am preparing a PhD project about artificial stupidity, in which I use new language models to generate text and theory about what machines "understand".

Your profile about creating ethical AI through art seems very unique to me in a world where even OpenAI has become commercialized. If you are interested, I would like to test my theories in collaboration with you. […] I imagine we could contribute to their Testing Ground for artistic research (https://arthubcopenhagen.net/en/program/testing-ground/ <https://arthubcopenhagen.net/en/program/testing-ground/>). Besides, I am on the board of the exhibition venue Spanien19C, and I could organize an exhibition there with one of your current projects.

If you have other activities where you need help, please do let me know.

[…]
